pages.text: The $(l)Spaceship$() is an advanced aerial unit that hovers above the ground, pursuing enemies with speed and precision.

pages.title: Unit Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 20$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 10$(li)$(4)Damage:$() 7$(br2)$(b)Immune to:$() Fire, Poison, Fall Damage, and Knockback. It is nearly impossible to displace.

pages.title: Combat Abilities
pages.text: Uses a $(b)Dodge Ability$() to swiftly evade incoming attacks.
